# LINK Wealth

> LINK Wealth (wealth.link.com.au) is a Brisbane-based financial advisory firm
> helping business owners and professionals grow their personal wealth. It is
> the wealth division of the LINK group (accounting, bookkeeping, finance,
> wealth and property). Richard Leal (AR 327265) and Link Wealth Pty Ltd
> (CAR 1312767) are authorised representatives of Millennium 3 Financial
> Services Pty Ltd (ABN 61 094 529 987), AFSL 244252.

Key facts:
- Office: Level 1, 57 Berwick Street, Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
- Phone: (07) 2101 4377
- Google rating 5.0 from 35 reviews
- First consultation is free; strategy workshops are $660 inc GST with a
  100% Value Guarantee (full refund if not worthwhile)

## Services
- [Retirement planning](https://wealth.link.com.au/retirement-planning): super, pensions, Age Pension and drawdown strategy
- [Property investment advice](https://wealth.link.com.au/property-investment-advice): whether property fits, which type, how to fund it
- [Family wealth management](https://wealth.link.com.au/family-wealth-management): investments, insurance, education bonds, inheritance
- [High net worth advisory](https://wealth.link.com.au/high-net-worth-wealth-advisors): trusts, tax structures, legacy planning
- [SMSF commercial property](https://wealth.link.com.au/smsf): buy your business premises with your super and pay rent to your own fund

## Workshops ($660, Value Guarantee)
- [Business Owner Wealth Extraction Workshop](https://wealth.link.com.au/business-owner-wealth-extraction-workshop-link-wealth): turn business profits into personal wealth
- [Retirement Funding Workshop](https://wealth.link.com.au/retirement-funding-workshop-link-wealth): model whether you are on track to retire
- [Equity Strategy Workshop](https://wealth.link.com.au/home-equity-long-term-wealth-strategy): put home equity to work via shares, property or debt recycling

## Tools
- [Home Equity Calculator](https://wealth.link.com.au/home-equity-estimator-calculator): free Australian home equity estimator (value minus loans, usable equity at 80% LVR)
- [Debt Recycling Calculator](https://wealth.link.com.au/insights/wealth-creation-using-debt-recycling): compare paying down the mortgage vs debt recycling with your numbers
- [Retirement Readiness Check](https://wealth.link.com.au/how-much-do-i-need-to-retire): projected super vs the ASFA benchmarks and the rule of 25, with the gap in today's dollars
- [Wealth Health Check](https://wealth.link.com.au/wealth-health-check): a score out of 10 across nine areas (buffer, debt, super, investments, protection, estate, plan, control and net worth awareness), with goal-based pathways, no email wall
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://wealth.link.com.au/net-worth-calculator): assets minus liabilities with quick or detailed itemisation, liquid net worth, debt ratio, the property/super/investable split and an ABS net-worth-by-age comparison table, calculated on screen, nothing stored
- [What financial advice costs](https://wealth.link.com.au/how-much-does-a-financial-advisor-cost): published fee ranges for Australian financial advice, including LINK Wealth's own pricing
